message.content: {"label": "RISKY", "explanation": "The original code caught `AttributeError` to handle cases where `scope.span` is `None` (accessing `.span_id` on `None` raises `AttributeError`), but the new code only checks `scope.span is not None` before the context manager exits — however, `sentry_sdk.configure_scope()` could also raise other exceptions or `scope` itself could be `None` in some SDK versions, and more importantly the refactor is functionally equivalent only if `scope.span` is the sole source of `AttributeError`; if `scope` itself lacks a `span` attribute in some SDK version, the new code will raise an unhandled `AttributeError` instead of gracefully falling back."}
